title: H and E
summary: Two new keys: H and E. The finger goes out, presses, and comes back.
intro: Two new keys in this lesson: H and E. They belong to your left middle finger and your right middle finger. The movement is always the same — out, press, back — and the way back is the part being trained, because a finger left out of place spoils the next letter.
congrats: Two more keys under your fingers. If H and E already come without searching, the lesson has done its job.

screens.text: This key belongs to your left middle finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only H and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.
